driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s

step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data

        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components.
chrono.ChEngine.Initialize()

# Create the main simulation system
system = chrono.ChSystem()

# 2. Add the required physical systems and objects as specified.

# Create a Kraz vehicle
vehicle = chrono.ChVehicle()

# Create a rigid terrain
terrain = chrono.ChTerrain()
terrain.SetGridSize(200, 200)
terrain.SetFrictionCoefficient(0.8)
terrain.SetRestitutionCoefficient(0.3)

# Add terrain to the system
system.Add(terrain.GetGroundBody())

# 3. Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions.

# Set initial vehicle position
vehicle.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 2))

# Create a driver system for vehicle control
driver = chrono.ChDriver()
driver.SetVehicle(vehicle)

# Create a real-time visualization using Irrlicht
vis = irr.ChIrrApp(system, "Kraz Vehicle Simulation", chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVector3d(0, -1, 0), True)

# Set up Irrlicht camera settings and lighting
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1))
vis.SetCameraDistance(20)
vis.SetLight(chrono.ChVector3d(10, 10, 10))

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run() and system.GetChTimeStep() < 30:
    # Synchronize and advance the vehicle, terrain, driver, and visual system at each timestep
    vis.Synchronize("", driver.GetSteering())
    system.DoStepDynamics(0.02)
    vis.Advance(0.02)

# Cleanup
del vis
chrono.ChEngine.Finalize()

        driver_inputs.steering = -0.5
    else:
        driver_inputs.steering = 0

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
